Quick win: a 2‑minute focus reset you can do anytime

- 0:00–0:20 — Clear the deck: close all nonessential tabs/apps, put phone on Do Not Disturb, tidy what’s in arm’s reach.
- 0:20–1:00 — Box breathe: inhale 4s, hold 4s, exhale 4s, hold 4s (repeat twice) to drop stress and steady attention.
- 1:00–1:30 — Externalize: brain‑dump any open loops onto a note. Circle the single next action that moves your main task forward.
- 1:30–2:00 — Frictionless start: open only the doc/app you need for that action, set a 10‑minute timer, and begin.

Why it works: reduces cognitive load, calms your nervous system, and removes choice friction so you start instead of stall.

Optional boosters:
- Put your phone in another room or face‑down behind you.
- If noise distracts you, use brown noise or a simple instrumental loop.
- After the 10 minutes, take a 30–60s stand‑stretch, then continue in 25–30 minute blocks.

.github/workflows/build.yml
name: build-assets
on: [push]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        theme: [bw, accent]
        locale: [en, es, de, fr]
    env:
      # Persist Chromium downloads between runs (cache step below)
      PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR: ~/.cache/puppeteer
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20.x'

      # Cache npm deps
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: npm-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            npm-${{ runner.os }}-

      # Cache Puppeteer Chromium downloads
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/puppeteer
          key: pptr-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            pptr-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: npm ci

      # Install base fonts so Chromium renders clean fallbacks for Inter
      - name: Install fonts (Noto + Emoji)
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y fonts-noto fonts-noto-cjk fonts-noto-color-emoji

      - name: Render templates
        run: THEME=${{ matrix.theme }} LOCALES=${{ matrix.locale }} npm run render

      - name: Build with suffix
        run: |
          HTML=focus-reset.${{ matrix.locale }}.${{ matrix.theme }}.html
          IOS=focus-reset-ios.${{ matrix.locale }}.${{ matrix.theme }}.svg
          AND=focus-reset-android.${{ matrix.locale }}.${{ matrix.theme }}.svg
          node build.js --ci --html "$HTML" --ios "$IOS" --android "$AND" --suffix "${{ matrix.locale }}_${{ matrix.theme }}"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: focus-reset-assets_${{ matrix.locale }}_${{ matrix.theme }}
          path: |
            focus-reset_letter_${{ matrix.locale }}_${{ matrix.theme }}.pdf

Goal: shorter copy that fits smaller devices; hides the “Boosts” line.

Renderer changes (i18n/render.js)
- Add LOCK mode and compact logic:
const LOCK = process.env.LOCK || 'normal'; // 'normal' | 'compact'
const showBoosts = LOCK === 'normal' ? ['1'] : []; // truthy section flag

// Choose steps set for SVGs
const stepsIOS = (LOCK === 'compact' && src.lock_steps_compact) ? src.lock_steps_compact : src.lock_steps;
const stepsAND = (LOCK === 'compact' && src.lock_steps_compact) ? src.lock_steps_compact : src.lock_steps;

// Apply Y positions
const iosSteps = (stepsIOS || []).map((text, i) => ({ text, y: lockStepY('ios')[i] }));
const andSteps = (stepsAND || []).map((text, i) => ({ text, y: lockStepY('android')[i] }));

// Size tweaks for compact (fallback if per-locale not set)
if (LOCK === 'compact') {
  sizes.ios.title = Math.max(40, sizes.ios.title - 4);
  sizes.ios.step = Math.max(26, sizes.ios.step - 2);
  sizes.ios.boost = Math.max(22, sizes.ios.boost - 2);
  sizes.android.title = Math.max(38, sizes.android.title - 4);
  sizes.android.step = Math.max(26, sizes.android.step - 2);
  sizes.android.boost = Math.max(22, sizes.android.boost - 2);
}

Hardened GitHub Actions (matrix + caching + fonts + pinned Node)
.github/workflows/build.yml
name: build-assets
on: [push]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        theme: [bw, accent]
        locale: [en, es, de, fr]
    env:
      # Persist Chromium downloads between runs (cache step below)
      PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR: ~/.cache/puppeteer
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20.x'

      # Cache npm deps
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: npm-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            npm-${{ runner.os }}-

      # Cache Puppeteer Chromium downloads
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/puppeteer
          key: pptr-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            pptr-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: npm ci

      # Install base fonts so Chromium renders clean fallbacks for Inter
      - name: Install fonts (Noto + Emoji)
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y fonts-noto fonts-noto-cjk fonts-noto-color-emoji

      - name: Render templates
        run: THEME=${{ matrix.theme }} LOCALES=${{ matrix.locale }} npm run render

      - name: Build with suffix
        run: |
          HTML=focus-reset.${{ matrix.locale }}.${{ matrix.theme }}.html
          IOS=focus-reset-ios.${{ matrix.locale }}.${{ matrix.theme }}.svg
          AND=focus-reset-android.${{ matrix.locale }}.${{ matrix.theme }}.svg
          node build.js --ci --html "$HTML" --ios "$IOS" --android "$AND" --suffix "${{ matrix.locale }}_${{ matrix.theme }}"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: focus-reset-assets_${{ matrix.locale }}_${{ matrix.theme }}
          path: |
            focus-reset_letter_${{ matrix.locale }}_${{ matrix.theme }}.pdf
            focus-reset_a4_${{ matrix.locale }}_${{ matrix.theme }}.pdf
            focus-reset_ios_1170x2532_${{ matrix.locale }}_${{ matrix.theme }}.png
            focus-reset_android_1080x2400_${{ matrix.locale }}_${{ matrix.theme }}.png
            focus-reset_assets_v1_${{ matrix.locale }}_${{ matrix.theme }}.zip
            checksums_${{ matrix.locale }}_${{ matrix.theme }}.txt

      - uses: actions/cache@v4

const LOCK = process.env.LOCK || 'normal'; // 'normal' | 'compact'
const showBoosts = LOCK === 'normal' ? ['1'] : []; // truthy section flag

// Choose steps set for SVGs
const stepsIOS = (LOCK === 'compact' && src.lock_steps_compact) ? src.lock_steps_compact : src.lock_steps;
const stepsAND = (LOCK === 'compact' && src.lock_steps_compact) ? src.lock_steps_compact : src.lock_steps;

// Apply Y positions
const iosSteps = (stepsIOS || []).map((text, i) => ({ text, y: lockStepY('ios')[i] }));
const andSteps = (stepsAND || []).map((text, i) => ({ text, y: lockStepY('android')[i] }));

// Size tweaks for compact (fallback if per-locale not set)
if (LOCK === 'compact') {
  sizes.ios.title = Math.max(40, sizes.ios.title - 4);
  sizes.ios.step = Math.max(26, sizes.ios.step - 2);

Hotel shortlist (4 nights, mid-September 2026, A/C, quiet rooms, in/near Chiado–Baixa–Príncipe Real)
- Brown’s Central Hotel (Baixa, 4★): ~$170–210/night. Stylish, great location, ask for an interior/courtyard-facing high floor for quiet. brownscentralhotel.com
- Lisboa Pessoa Hotel (Chiado/Carmo, 4★): ~$190–240/night. Rooftop views, spa; request upper floors away from street. lisboapessoahotel.com
- The Vintage Lisbon (Avenida/Príncipe Real edge, 5★ boutique): ~$220–280/night. Quiet rooms, rooftop bar; ask for higher floors facing the back. thevintagelisboa.com
Notes: Book early for mid-September. Expect Lisbon city tax (~€2 pp/night).

Day 1 — Sun, Sept 14: Baixa + Chiado + Alfama, short Tram 28, Fado evening
- 10:00 Start at Praça do Comércio → Baixa grid stroll up Rua Augusta. Optional Arco da Rua Augusta terrace (great intro view; 15–30 min).
  - Transit: Walk/metro Baixa-Chiado. Steps today target: 10–13k.
- 11:15 Elevador de Santa Justa (view lines), or walk up to Carmo Convent terrace and Largo do Carmo.
- 12:30 Lunch (Chiado/Baixa):
  - Bairro do Avillez (seafood/tapas; avoid pork dishes) $$–$$$; book for indoor seating.
  - Oficina do Duque (Portuguese bistro, good fish) $$; reserve or arrive early.
  - Time Out Market (variety, busy at peak) $–$$; no booking.
- 14:00 Alfama meander: Sé Cathedral exterior → Miradouro de Santa Luzia → Portas do Sol.
- 15:30 Short Tram 28 ride: Board at Largo das Portas do Sol toward Graça for a few scenic stops, then hop off at Graça. Use contactless or a 24h pass; avoid boarding at Martim Moniz (crowds).
- 16:15 Miradouro da Senhora do Monte (top view; consider Uber up, walk down to spare steps).
- 18:00 Break at your hotel.
- 19:30 Fado dinner (Alfama/Baixa):
  - Clube de Fado $$$; classic, book well ahead (minimum spend; mention no pork preferences).
  - Adega Machado (Bairro Alto) $$–$$$; set menus; reserve.
  - Tasca do Chico (Bairro Alto) $–$$; informal, often lines; arrive early.
- Approx costs today: Food $110–140, sights $10–20 (Arco), transit $6–12.

Day 2 — Mon, Sept 15: Belém + MAAT + LX Factory (Pastéis de Belém)
- 10:00 Cais do Sodré → Tram 15E or bus 728 to Belém (25–30 min). Consider Navegante 24h pass (~€6.80) for trams/buses/metro.
- 10:45 Jerónimos Monastery (timed entry; 60–90 min). Go straight to the cloister line for your time slot.
- 12:15 Pastéis de Belém bakery: Take-away queue is separate and faster; get warm pastéis plus coffee.
- 13:00 Lunch (Belém):
  - Enoteca de Belém (wine + seafood-friendly plates) $$–$$$; reserve.
  - Pão Pão Queijo Queijo (quick, casual) $.
  - Este Oeste (riverside, pizzas/sushi; easy seating) $$.
- 14:30 MAAT (museum + riverside architecture; 60 min) or Coach Museum (if you prefer; 45–60 min).
- 16:00 Belém Tower exterior/photos (interior often queues; skip inside to save time/steps).
- 16:45 Bus 714/728 or Uber (~10–15 min) to LX Factory. Explore street art, Ler Devagar bookshop, small design stores.
- 19:00 Dinner (LX Factory):
  - 1300 Taberna $$–$$$; book.
  - Moules & Co $$; walk-in often OK.
  - Café na Fábrica $–$$; relaxed.
- 20:30 Uber back (10–15 min).
- Approx costs today: Food $110–140, sights $20–35 (Jerónimos + MAAT), transit $8–15.

Day 3 — Tue, Sept 16: Sintra day trip (Pena Palace + Quinta da Regaleira)
- 09:40 Rossio Station → Sintra (train ~40 min; trains every ~20–30 min; use Viva Viagem or contactless).
- 10:30 Arrive Sintra. Uber/bolt or 434 bus to Parque da Pena entrance (Uber ~€6–10; bus pass ~€7.60).
- 11:00 Pena Palace timed interior slot (allow 1.5–2 h total; shuttle inside the park up to palace is ~€3 per person if you want to minimize uphill walking).
- 13:15 Lunch in Sintra town:
  - Tascantiga (petiscos, seafood/veg options) $$; try to reserve.
  - Incomum by Luis Santos $$–$$$; book.
  - Piriquita bakery for a quick bite (travesseiros) $.
- 14:45 Quinta da Regaleira (1.5–2 h; gardens + Initiation Well; moderate walking).
- 17:00 Train back to Lisbon (Rossio). Short rest.
- 19:45 Dinner (Chiado/Príncipe Real):
  - Solar dos Presuntos (seafood, cod specialties) $$–$$$; book.
  - Cervejaria Ramiro (shellfish) $$–$$$; take a number/expect wait; go early.
  - Sea Me (modern seafood) $$–$$$; reserve.
- Approx costs today (2 adults): Train ~$12, Sintra local transport $15–25, tickets Pena ~$44, Regaleira ~$26, food $110–150. Total ~$210–250.

Day 4 — Wed, Sept 17: Tiles + Street Art + Viewpoints
- 10:00 Museu Nacional do Azulejo (Tile Museum). Taxi/Uber (~10 min from Baixa) or bus 759; 1.5–2 h. Don’t miss the Lisbon panorama azulejos.
- 12:30 Lunch:
  - Cacophony (near Santa Apolónia; modern, seafood/veg) $$; reserve.
  - O Velho Eurico (simple Portuguese; order non-pork fish/chicken) $–$$; go early.
  - Prado Mercearia (light plates, natural wines) $$.
- 14:30 Street art tour (e.g., Lisbon Street Art Tours, 2.5–3 h; Bairro Alto/Mouraria/Alcântara routes; ~€25–30 pp). Minimal hills on most routes; confirm route when booking.
- 18:00 Miradouro de São Pedro de Alcântara (easy access from Bairro Alto; funicular Glória if needed).
- 19:45 Dinner (Bairro Alto/Príncipe Real):
  - A Cevicheria (Peruvian seafood) $$–$$$; small, arrive before opening or reserve.
  - Tapisco (Iberian plates; choose non-pork options) $$–$$$; book.
  - Tasca da Esquina (Campo de Ourique; short Uber) $$–$$$; reserve.
- Approx costs: Sights ~$20, tour ~$60, transit/Uber ~$10–20, food $110–140.

Day 5 — Thu, Sept 18: Chiado/Principe Real easy day + last views
- 10:00 Specialty coffee + light breakfast:
  - Fabrica Coffee Roasters (Chiado) $.
  - Copenhagen Coffee Lab (multiple) $.
  - Manteigaria (nata + espresso) $.
- 11:00 Carmo Archaeological Museum (roofless convent; 45–60 min).
- 12:30 Shopping/streets: Chiado (A Vida Portuguesa, Livraria Bertrand) or Príncipe Real design stores/Embaixada gallery.
- 13:30 Lunch:
  - Pão da Dó (light, salads/sandwiches) $.
  - Zé da Mouraria 2 (grilled fish; early for walk-in) $–$$.
  - Jardim dos Sentidos (veg-friendly) $–$$.
- 15:00 Optional: Gulbenkian Museum (short Uber/metro; 1.5–2 h; cool, calm galleries) or Oceanário if you prefer aquariums (longer trip; add Uber/metro time).
- 18:30 Sunset drink:
  - Park Bar (rooftop; arrive early).
  - Topo Chiado (by Carmo; relaxed).
- 20:00 Farewell dinner:
  - Taberna da Rua das Flores (Portuguese, daily chalkboard; arrive before opening or expect wait) $$.
  - Sacramento do Chiado (classic Portuguese; seafood options) $$–$$$; book.
  - Zé da Mouraria (if not already; early).
- Approx costs: Sights $15–30, transit $6–12, food $110–140.

Booking tips and key links
- Jerónimos Monastery: Buy timed tickets in advance; choose morning/late afternoon to avoid peak. Official: patrimoniodocultural.gov.pt (search Mosteiro dos Jerónimos).
- Belém Tower: Often long queues and cramped interior. Consider exterior only, or go right at opening. Tickets also via patrimoniodocultural.gov.pt.
- MAAT: maat.pt; buy online or at door.
- National Tile Museum: mnazulejo.en.museum (or Google “Museu Nacional do Azulejo tickets”).
- Tram/metro: Get a Viva Viagem card at metro; consider 24h pass on Belém day. Carris/Metro info: carris.pt, metrolisboa.pt.
- Sintra:
  - Trains: cp.pt (Lisbon Rossio ↔ Sintra).
  - Pena Palace: parquesdesintra.pt; buy Park + Palace ticket with timed interior slot. Arrive 30–40 min before slot to clear park gate and shuttle/walk up.
  - Quinta da Regaleira: quintadaregaleira.pt; buy online to skip purchase queue (no strict time slots typically).
  - Getting around: 434 bus loop (Palácio da Pena) or Uber/Bolt to minimize lines/walking; allow 15–20 min from park gate to palace.
- Fado: Book well ahead (Clube de Fado, Adega Machado). Confirm minimum spend and show times when reserving.

Transit notes and routes
- Airport–central (if needed): Metro Red Line → Green Line to Baixa-Chiado, or Uber ~20–30 min off-peak.
- Belém: Tram 15E or buses 714/728 from Cais do Sodré/ Praça da Figueira; ~25–35 min each way.
- Sintra: Rossio Station; contactless or top-up Viva Viagem. In Sintra use 434 bus or rideshare to cut hills.
- Hills/steps: Use Elevador da Glória (Restauradores ↔ São Pedro de Alcântara) and the Bica funicular (Chiado ↔ Cais do Sodré) to save steps.

Estimated budget (2 adults, excluding flights)
- Hotel (choose Brown’s Central estimate): $180/night × 4 = $720
- Food and drinks: Average ~$110/day × 5 = $550
- Activities/museums/tours (Jerónimos, MAAT, Tile Museum, Arco, Carmo, street art tour, Fado cover/min spend, Sintra sites): ~$260–320
- Local transit (Viva Viagem cards, a 24h pass day, trams/metro/buses + occasional Ubers): ~$90–120
- Total estimated: ~$1,620–1,710 (comfortable within $1,800). If you choose higher-end dinners or a pricier hotel, expect ~$1,800–1,950.

Weather and packing (mid-September)
- Typical highs 24–28°C (75–82°F), lows 17–20°C (62–68°F). Mostly sunny, low chance of rain; UV can be strong.
- Pack breathable layers, light jacket for evenings, sunhat/sunscreen, and shoes with good grip for cobblestones. Bring a small umbrella just in case.
- Contactless cards widely accepted; carry a little cash for small cafés. Watch for pickpockets on crowded trams and in tourist zones.

Would you like me to:
- Price-check and pick one hotel now?
- Pre-build a booking checklist (links + sequence + target times) for Jerónimos, Sintra, Fado, and the street art tour?
- Swap any meals for specific dietary preferences (no pork already noted) or add more café stops?

Plan B (rain/crowds, quick swaps saved to phone)
- Mon Sep 14 (city + Fado)
  - If rain: Prioritize indoor stops (Carmo Archaeological Museum, Money Museum; coffee at Fabrica or Copenhagen Coffee Lab). Tram 28 crowded? Uber to Miradouro da Senhora do Monte and walk down if/when clear.
  - If lines at Santa Justa: Skip and use the Carmo terrace for similar views.
- Tue Sep 15 (Sintra)
  - If heavy rain or palace delays: Swap order—do Regaleira first if its line is lighter, or focus on interiors (Pena + Sintra National Palace in town) and skip some gardens. For lunch, Café Saudade or Tascantiga (indoors). Bring light rain jackets; paths can be slick.
  - If transport hiccups: Use Uber/Bolt instead of 434; return to Lisbon earlier and have a relaxed Chiado afternoon.
- Wed Sep 16 (Tile Museum + Street art)
  - If street art tour rained out: Ask operator to shift to Thu morning; or swap to indoor culture (Gulbenkian Museum) and do a self-guided street art peek at LX Factory when dry.
- Thu Sep 17 (MAAT + LX Factory)
